rubrics.rationale: This case's core relation is a package-wide dormant compatibility layer; the repair is complete only when every one of its five dispatch surfaces has been freed of the permanently-off route, not just the most visible one.

rubrics.rationale: The async entry point and its helper form one lifecycle-coupled pair from the real pre-2.0 history of this package; removing the branch but keeping the exclusively-serving helper (or vice versa) is the canonical partial fix this instance must distinguish from a complete one.
